Priya (AE): Quick sync request 026-03-14. Helios Biotech sent MSA+DPA redlines + PO intent. Main asks: BYOK/HSM addendum, 7yr audit log retention, choice of law = DE, PO net45 referencing sku. Need legal/finance/solutions input so we can send envelope.

Marta (Legal): Upload the redlines please. 7 years is likely a hard no; propose 3 years for regulated healthcare and escalate if needed. We have a KMS addendum template ready; need to confirm key exchange method (PKCS#11 vs cloud KMS). Also will push back on any expanded indemnity.

Ola (Finance): Net45 is acceptable for POC but we'll need PO to reference line items and billing contact + VAT ID. If they want HSM professional services, ask to list as separate line. Provide sample PO format and we'll validate against AR.

Tanner (Solutions): Technical: EU data residency + dedicated pool ok. HSM/BYOK adds provisioning time (~2 weeks) and SOW. If they want on-prem appliance expect ~50% uplift. Need technical lead contact and cert format (PEM/PFX).

Katerina (PS): I'll draft a short SOW and time estimate. For HSM integration we need their security engineer on-call during provisioning. Recommend PKCS#11.

ContractsBot: Drafted envelope env_0xD9F0 with attachments placeholder. Default Redwood signers = Legal Director + VP Revenue. To use single exec signer request CRO approval.

ApprovalsBot: CRO pre-approval required for single-signer exceptions. Submit request to queue to speed e-sign.

Priya (AE): Uploading redlines and procurement contact (lena@helios.io) now. Customer asked for SOC2 + pentest report; can Legal share under one-way NDA?

Marta (Legal): Yes, we can share SOC2 + pentest under a one-way NDA. I'll prepare the DPA response with tracked changes and attach KMS addendum. I'll propose audit retention = 3 years and note export-control carveouts for biotech.

Ola (Finance): I'll confirm VAT handling and sample PO template. Please ensure PO includes: PO#, Bill-to, Line items (RED-DED-POC-M, RED-HSM-SETUP), billing email.

Priya (AE): Thanks all. Goal: get countersigned MSA + PO by end of week. I'll coordinate with Lena for PO and tech lead availability. Ping me if Approvals needed. :pray:
